g.text: Where GENCO goes wrong, and why

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'TeX Gyre Heros'; fill: #57564f

g.text: Its errors grow when outages cluster in one area, the pattern of storms and wildfires. Probing it with small,

text.style: font-size: 11.5px; font-family: 'TeX Gyre Heros'; fill: #57564f

g.text: realistic changes shows why: GENCO largely follows local physics, but under-reacts when the whole system is stressed.

text.style: font-size: 8.5px; font-family: 'TeX Gyre Heros'; text-anchor: start; fill: #8d8c86

g.text: a: notebook `clustered_outages`, 42 to 60 cases per group; bars are medians. b: notebook `load_response`, 129 scenarios, linearised from ±2 % changes; line: median slope.
